row: Holistic Touch Therapy offers massage and acupressure classes for competitive, working, recreational, and infirm canine athletes. These modalities can stimulate the canine competitor, energize the working dog, invigorate the couch potato and improve fitness in all dogs. Massage and acupressure can also comfort and encourage healing in a sick or injured dog, relax the stressed or anxious dog, and build confidence in the shy, abused, neglected or rescued dog by promoting homeostatic balance in the body's organ systems.
